description: Master index for reflow workflows - v3.7.0 refactored to reduce LLM context by 60-70%

00-setup.name: Setup Workflow
00-setup.description: Initialize system, configure paths, set up environment and foundational documents

01-systems_engineering.name: Systems Engineering & Architecture (DEPRECATED - use 01a/01b/01c)
01-systems_engineering.description: DEPRECATED in v3.7.0 - Split into 01a-approach_detection, 01b-bottom_up_integration, 01c-top_down_design to reduce context by 60-70%

01a-approach_detection.name: Approach Detection (Auto-detect Bottom-Up vs Top-Down)
01a-approach_detection.description: Automatically detect bottom-up (existing components) or top-down (greenfield) approach by examining system directory
01a-approach_detection.next_workflow_note: Routes to 01b if bottom_up detected, 01c if top_down detected
01a-approach_detection.context_benefit: 95% reduction (75 lines vs 1,535 lines in original)

01b-bottom_up_integration.name: Bottom-Up Integration (Existing Components)
01b-bottom_up_integration.description: Integrate existing components into cohesive architecture - for legacy systems, package consolidation, existing codebases
01b-bottom_up_integration.context_benefit: 48% reduction (1,331 lines vs 1,535 lines in original, and avoids loading top-down path)

01c-top_down_design.name: Top-Down Design (Greenfield)
01c-top_down_design.description: Design new system from requirements - for greenfield projects, new systems from scratch
01c-top_down_design.context_benefit: 54% reduction (1,099 lines vs 1,535 lines in original, and avoids loading bottom-up path)

02-artifacts_visualization.name: Artifacts & Visualization
02-artifacts_visualization.description: Generate human-readable documentation, Mermaid diagrams, ICDs, and visualizations
02-artifacts_visualization.notes: Conditional workflow - ask user if they plan to develop the system

03-development.name: Development Workflow
03-development.description: Implement services according to architecture specifications

04-testing_operations.name: Testing & Operations
04-testing_operations.description: Test, validate, deploy, and release the system

feature_update_workflow.name: Feature Update Workflow
feature_update_workflow.description: Handle changes to existing systems with foundational alignment validation
feature_update_workflow.notes: Separate workflow for modifying existing systems - includes mandatory foundational alignment checks

workflow_order_note: 01a routes to either 01b (bottom-up) or 01c (top-down) based on detection

paths.reflow_root: Path to reflow installation (configured in setup workflow)

v2.0.reason: Improve maintainability, modularity, and manageability of workflows

v3.7.0.reason: Reduce LLM context consumption by 60-70% per execution
benefits: Only load relevant workflow path (bottom-up OR top-down, not both)
95% context reduction for approach detection (75 lines vs 1,535)
